description.text: Metal pourer career guide: O*NET/BLS 51-4052 mould inspection, temperature measurement and sampling and pouring, 2025 US wages and employment, the Chinese statistical gap, AI assistance and a fictional mould inspection exercise.

subject.name: Pourers and Casters, Metal
subject.summary: Pourers and casters on this page means metal pourers specifically: they inspect moulds to the process, check temperature readings and samples and equipment positions, and operate approved ladles or manual controls to pour molten metal into moulds to make castings or ingots. O*NET 51-4052.00 provides the specific tasks; US wages and employment use the separate BLS 51-4052 occupation and do not cover all moulding, melting or die casting positions. Real high-temperature and lifting work follows site training and authorization.
